BiblicalUsage: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee, says Isaiah — the throng of gods and helpers Israel trusted in. The wind carries them all away, but he that puts his trust in God shall possess the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a throng of idols cannot deliver, and Isaiah's taunt still stands: let your companies save you, if they can.
